dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: The Windblume Festival... Hmph, it's that time of the year again, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: I had an epiphany when I got divorced, and it was like waking from a long dream: the Windblume Festival should never have been associated with love at all!

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Hah, it must have been the scheme of some scheming city merchants. Wouldn't they love to package every festival as something for lovers?

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: ...People in love have no rational thought to speak of. A little flattery here and there and their wallets open wide.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I've come to my senses now. These festivals are absolutely meaningless.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: ...And if not for the Windblume Festival, would I even have met that man? Hmph...
